page_title: LM Studio Bionic - Your Agent for Work and Code

summary.name: LM Studio Bionic
summary.one_liner: Bionic is LM Studio's agent for work and code that runs open models locally on your computer, with options to use frontier open models.
use_cases: Creating and editing documents with an agent
summary.what_it_does: Bionic is an agent that works on documents, code, and computer tasks, with edits to documents saved automatically. It includes real-time voice transcription that the page says is processed locally and supports multiple languages. It can download local LLMs inside the app for chats or agentic tasks, using the LM Studio runtime with MLX and llama.cpp. For harder work, the page says it can run frontier open models such as GLM 5.2, Kimi K3, and DeepSeek V4 Pro.
notable: Natively local agent using LM Studio runtime with MLX and llama.cpp
Real-time voice transcription processed on-device, multilingual
Option to run frontier open models such as GLM 5.2, Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4 Pro
Cloud services stated as Zero Data Retention (ZDR)
caveats: Page does not state pricing or whether Bionic is free
Frontier open models are an option for demanding tasks; the page does not say whether they are local or cloud-hosted
Supported operating systems are not named on the page
